scoring_justification: The checker reimplements the exact Hubbard dimer Hamiltonian and thermodynamic formulas to recompute all gold values for each condition, then compares agent's reported scalars against the recomputed gold.

hidden_assets.purpose: Provides condition parameters for gold recomputation and defines tolerances.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Conditions are exactly those given in the public instruction; gold is computed on-the-fly by the checker using the paper's exact model.
hidden_assets.generation_method: The checker builds the Hamiltonian matrix, diagonalizes, and applies thermodynamic formulas identical to those in the reference solve.sh, ensuring consistency without pre‑stored numeric gold.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: No artificial numbers are embedded; all gold values are derived from the paper's physical model, making the verification faithful to the original work.

outputs.description: Computed thermodynamic and caloric quantities for the Hubbard dimer at specified parameter conditions. Each scalar must be reported for the exact condition defined in the instruction (e.g., U/t, H/t, E|e|d/t, k_B T/t, x). All quantities are computed in the grand canonical ensemble at half-filling (x=1) as per the paper's main analysis. The checker will compare each value to hidden gold references within appropriate relative tolerances: 1e-5 for normalized energies and 1e-4 for other quantities.

output_contract.notes: The output file must contain an array of conditions as described. The parameter conditions themselves are provided in the instruction. The verification compares each reported scalar directly to gold values derived from the paper; no recomputation from eigenenergies is performed by the checker.

steps.description: Recompute eigenenergies from the Hubbard Hamiltonian and compare to agent-reported values.
Recompute all derived thermodynamic quantities from the Hamiltonian and compare to agent-reported values.
